headline: Soccer Teams by Region
body: Professional clubs and college programs across the West. From MLS to USL, NWSL to NCAA — find the teams in your region.
proIntro: Professional clubs across MLS, NWSL, USL Championship, USL Super League, and USL League One. Check each club's official site for current schedules, tickets, and rosters.
collegeIntro: NCAA Division I, II, and III programs across the region. Check each school's athletics site for current rosters, schedules, and coaching staff.
collegeNote: Conference affiliations and program status can change. Verify current membership and active programs with the school's athletics department.
